title: kissed sashimi-cut irish pepper hot-pot
description: a garlicky, bouncy irish dish featuring roasted peppers and sashimi-cut hot pot

ingredients.name: roasted red bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color bell pepper will do, but red is the most flavorful

ingredients.name: salted cod
ingredients.notes: any firm white fish works, but salted cod is authentic to the irish version of this dish

ingredients.name: sweet butter
ingredients.notes: use high-quality, salted butter for the best flavor

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: minced or crushed, whichever suits your preference

ingredients.name: hot pot broth
ingredients.notes: store-bought or homemade, whichever is easier for you

instructions: heat the sweet butter in a large hot pot vessel over medium heat.
add the garlic and saut7 until fragrant, about 1 minute.
add the roasted red bell peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
add the salted cod and cook for 3-4 minutes, until cooked through, but still flaky.
add the sushi-grade salmon and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through.
pour in the hot pot broth and bring to a simmer.
reduce heat to low and let cook for 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately, with a squeeze of lemon juice on top.
serve in bowls over rice, or with crusty bread for dipping in the broth.
be sure to serve with a side of crusty bread or crackers, for dipping in the broth.
